scientific_integrity: Analytic finite-group proof with enumerative checks for small elementary-abelian examples; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite groups, binary alphabet, all lazy maps, exact monoid generation. Uses published orbit-collapse lemmas and an all-quotient independence argument; generality does not extend to infinite groups.
title: Klein-quotient double-cosets classify minimal completions of binary cellular automata
